purpose: Medication-list review: identify synthetic T2DM records that meet a guideline organ-protection criterion and have no active, verified SGLT2-inhibitor entry. Output is a clinician review list, not a prescription or recommendation for an individual.
disclaimer: Illustrative demo rule on synthetic data; clinician validation required. It does not diagnose, prescribe, triage, or contact patients.

criteria.ascvd: Active, confirmed condition with a verified SNOMED CT code in the ASCVD demo subset.
criteria.egfr_method: CKD-EPI creatinine-based eGFR (LOINC 62238-1) only; other or unspecified equations are not compared.

references.ada_2026: ADA Standards of Care in Diabetes 2026 (Diabetes Care 49, Suppl. 1): SGLT2 inhibitor for T2D with ASCVD; for T2D with CKD, initiate when eGFR is at least 20 mL/min/1.73 m2.
references.moh_cpg_6e: MOH Malaysia CPG Management of T2DM, 6th Edition: GLP-1 RA and SGLT2 inhibitors reduce MACE in people with established ASCVD or high CV risk.
references.scope: Pregnancy-related records are out of scope, as in the T2DM review tree.
